title: Tillamook Forest Center

services.name: Class
services.desc: Any group* comprised of 10 or more individuals (including children and adults) must schedule their visit in advance of their arrival. This does not include families. It includes all groups wanting to visit the inside of the Tillamook Forest Center, including just quick bathroom stops. In-Depth Explorations include a warm welcome and site orientation to help you get the most out of your visit. TFC staff set expectations with youth and chaperones and provide scavenger hunt booklets, which are required to be used in the exhibit hall. services.name: Facility Rental
services.desc: Are you looking for a place to gather with a group in a beautiful setting? The Smith Homestead Forest Learning Shelter and Tillamook Forest Center are located at separate sites, a half mile from each other, and provide different amenities. At each location, you will be welcomed by the lush, forested setting of the scenic Oregon Coast Range. The facilities available for rent include the Forest Learning Shelter at the Smith Homestead Day-Use Area, and the Janet McLennan Community Room inside the Tillamook Forest Center, which can be divided into two spaces (Fireplace and River rooms). blurb: Whether you’re here just for us, attending an event, or simply stopping by on the way to the coast or the city, we have a forest of information to help you plan your visit - including details on weather, what to bring, amenities, food and beverage access, and accessibility. Remember, there's limited cell service in many parts of the forest!
